metadata.title: PyCon JP 2024
metadata.description: PyCon JP is a conference where Python users gather to exchange information and network about Python and software developed using Python.

overview.subtitle: Overview
overview.description: PyCon JP is a conference for Python users to gather, exchange information and interact with Python and software using Python. Through PyCon JP, the goal is to gather Python users together, exchange knowledge and information on various fields related to Python, connect with new friends and communities, and increase work and business opportunities.

sponsors.profile:

"SimpleCheck” revolutionizes the way corporate information is accessed. By simply requesting the name of a company, data scattered around the world is quickly aggregated and combined with unique insights to provide a comprehensive report within 30 seconds.
Meanwhile, “SimpleMonitor,” which consists of the same database as "SimpleCheck", constantly monitors the target company and automatically notifies the company of any changes in key information and attributes related to risk assessment.

SimpleForm Inc. is committed to increasing the efficiency and sophistication of the scrutiny process in financial and commercial transactions. By leveraging the synergy of cutting-edge technology and in-depth human research, we provide our clients with unparalleled insight and operational excellence.

sponsors.name: FireDucks
sponsors.profile:
FireDucks is a High-performance Compiler-accelerated Dataframe library with highly compatible pandas APIs.  It comes with a multithreaded kernel backend written in C++, an in-built JIT compiler, and a pure python frontend with highly-compatible pandas APIs allowing a native pandas application to be executed as it is without any manual changes. If you have a Pandas program, experience the acceleration of FireDucks today.
NEC, the developer of FireDucks, provides enterprise support for FireDucks.
Please contact us for more information.

However, many e-commerce sites other than Amazon still have a lot of issues with the purchase experience, such as “no returns/troublesome returns” and “not clear when it will be delivered”.
We at Recustomer believe that we can provide a better shopping experience for consumers, and advance the entire global economy by automating and streamlining the workflow of e-commerce infrastructure players such as e-commerce operators, warehouse operators, and shipping companies with our software. Together with us, we believe that we can advance the global economy. Join us in advancing the shopping experience in Japan and around the world.
